answer: A reputation market that prices identity the way a falcon prices its hunt: each new agent must stake a refundable deposit before it can transact, and the stake rises with every extra identity it spawns, so running a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand times more. Honest agents earn the stake back with interest as their work is attested, while a sybil caught lying forfeits it. The old fable of the jade merchant teaches the same lesson: one precious stone is trusted because it is costly to counterfeit, and a market that makes trust expensive to fake makes sybils unprofitable.
